title: पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira tries to soothe Shishupala, but Bhishma declares that Krishna is honoured not for kinship but for his wisdom, valour and fame, as the origin and end of the worlds. Let any who object do as they will.
summary.kn: ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಶಿಶುಪಾಲನನ್ನು ಸಮಾಧಾನಪಡಿಸಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಆದರೆ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಜ್ಞಾನ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮ ಕೀರ್ತಿಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ, ಲೋಕಗಳ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಲಯಸ್ಥಾನನಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಗೌರವ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮನು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಿಸುವವರು ಬೇಕಾದ್ದು ಮಾಡಲಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर शिशुपाल को मनाने का प्रयास करते हैं, पर भीष्म घोषणा करते हैं कि श्रीकृष्ण का सम्मान सम्बन्ध के कारण नहीं, बल्कि उनके ज्ञान, पराक्रम और यश के कारण है, क्योंकि वे लोकों के उद्गम और अन्त हैं। जो आपत्ति करे, वह जो चाहे करे।
summary.te: యుధిష్ఠిరుడు శిశుపాలుని శాంతపరచడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తాడు; కానీ శ్రీకృష్ణునికి బంధుత్వం కోసం కాక ఆయన జ్ఞానం, పరాక్రమం, కీర్తి కోసం, లోకాల ఉత్పత్తి లయస్థానం కనుక గౌరవం ఇచ్చామని భీష్ముడు ప్రకటిస్తాడు. అభ్యంతరపెట్టేవారు ఏమి చేయదలచుకుంటే అది చేయవచ్చంటాడు.
summary.ta: யுதிஷ்டிரர் ஶிஶுபாலனைச் சமாதானப்படுத்த முயல, ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணருக்கு உறவுக்காக அல்ல, அவர் ஞானம், வீரம், புகழுக்காக, உலகங்களின் தோற்றமும் முடிவுமாக இருப்பதால் மரியாதை செய்யப்பட்டது என்று பீஷ்மர் அறிவிக்கிறார். எதிர்ப்பவர்கள் விரும்பியதைச் செய்யட்டும் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ശിശുപാലനെ ശാന്തനാക്കാൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നു; എന്നാൽ കൃഷ്ണൻ ബന്ധുത്വം കൊണ്ടല്ല, ജ്ഞാനം, വീര്യം, കീർത്തി എന്നിവയാൽ ആദരിക്കപ്പെടുന്നുവെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുന്നു; ലോകങ്ങളുടെ ആദിയും അന്ത്യവും അദ്ദേഹമാണ്. എതിർക്കുന്നവർ ഇഷ്ടമുള്ളതു ചെയ്തുകൊള്ളട്ടെ എന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.35; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा शिशुपालमुपाद्रवत् ।
उवाच चैनं मधुरं सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira went up to Shishupala and spoke to him these words, sweet and conciliatory:

verses.text:
नेदं युक्तं महीपाल यादृशं वै त्वमुक्तवान् ।
अधर्मश्च परो राजन्पारुष्यं च निरर्थकम् ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said: Lord of the earth, what you have said is not right. It is a grave wrong, O king, and harshness without purpose.

verses.text:
न हि धर्मं परं जातु नावबुध्येत पार्थिव ।
भीष्मः शांतनवस्त्वेनं मावमंस्था अतोऽन्यथा ॥

meaning.en: King, one should never fail to understand the highest dharma. Do not slight Bhishma, son of Shantanu, in this way.

verses.text:
पश्य चेमान्महीपालांस्त्वत्तो वृद्धतमान्बहून् ।
मृष्यन्ते चार्हणां कृष्णे तद्वत्त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Look at these many kings, far older than you; they put up with the honour paid to Krishna, and you should bear it too.

verses.text:
वेद तत्त्वेन कृष्णं हि भीष्मश्चेदिपते भृशम् ।
न ह्येनं त्वं तथा वेत्थ यथैनं वेद कौरवः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of Chedi, Bhishma knows Krishna truly and deeply; you do not know him as the Kaurava does.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
नास्मा अनुनयो देयो नायमर्हति सान्त्वनम् ।
लोकवृद्धतमे कृष्णे योऽर्हणां नानुमन्यते ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma said: No coaxing should be given to him, nor does he deserve soothing, when he does not approve the honour of Krishna, the eldest in the world.

verses.text:
क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियं जित्वा रणे रणकृतां वरः ।
यो मुञ्चति वशे कृत्वा गुरुर्भवति तस्य सः ॥

meaning.en: When a Kshatriya, best of warriors, defeats a Kshatriya in battle and releases him after bringing him under his power, he becomes that man's teacher.

verses.text:
अस्यां च समितौ राज्ञामेकमप्यजितं युधि ।
न पश्यामि महीपालं सात्वतीपुत्रतेजसा ॥

meaning.en: In this assembly of kings I do not see a single ruler who has not been beaten in battle by the might of Satvati's son.

verses.text:
न हि केवलमस्माकमयमर्च्यतमोऽच्युतः ।
त्रयाणामपि लोकानामर्चनीयो जनार्दनः ॥

meaning.en: For not only to us is this imperishable one most worthy of honour; Janardana is to be honoured by all three worlds.

verses.text:
कृष्णेन हि जिता युद्धे बहवः क्षत्रियर्षभाः ।
जगत्सर्वं च वार्ष्णेये निखिलेन प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: For Krishna has defeated many bull-like Kshatriyas in battle, and the whole world rests entirely on the Vrishni.

verses.text:
तस्मात्सत्स्वपि वृद्धेषु कृष्णमर्चाम नेतरान् ।
एवं वक्तुं न चार्हस्त्वं मा भूत्ते बुद्धिरीदृशी ॥

meaning.en: Therefore, though elders are present, we honour Krishna and not others. You ought not to speak thus; let no such thought arise in you.

verses.text:
ज्ञानवृद्धा मया राजन्बहवः पर्युपासिताः ।
तेषां कथयतां शौरेरहं गुणवतो गुणान् ।
समागतानामश्रौषं बहून्बहुमतान्सताम् ॥

meaning.en: King, I have waited on many elders in knowledge, and I heard from those good men, much respected, as they gathered, about the virtues of the virtuous Shauri.

verses.text:
कर्माण्यपि च यान्यस्य जन्मप्रभृति धीमतः ।
बहुशः कथ्यमानानि नरैर्भूयः श्रुतानि मे ॥

meaning.en: And the deeds of this wise one, from his birth onward, I have heard recounted again and again by men.

verses.text:
न केवलं वयं कामाच्चेदिराज जनार्दनम् ।
न संबन्धं पुरस्कृत्य कृतार्थं वा कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Lord of Chedi, we do not honour Janardana out of desire, nor out of kinship, nor for any favour he has done us.

verses.text:
अर्चामहेऽर्चितं सद्भिर्भुवि भौमसुखावहम् ।
यशः शौर्यं जयं चास्य विज्ञायार्चां प्रयुज्महे ॥

meaning.en: We honour the one honoured by the good on earth, who brings earthly happiness; knowing his fame, valour and victory, we pay him honour.

verses.text:
न हि कश्चिदिहास्माभिः सुबालोऽप्यपरीक्षितः ।
गुणैर्वृद्धानतिक्रम्य हरिरर्च्यतमो मतः ॥

meaning.en: Here, no one, not even a mere boy, has been left untested by us; passing over those who are elders in virtue, we judge Hari most worthy of honour.

verses.text:
ज्ञानवृद्धो द्विजातीनां क्षत्रियाणां बलाधिकः ।
पूज्ये ताविह गोविन्दे हेतू द्वावपि संस्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: He is an elder in knowledge among the twice-born and greatest in strength among Kshatriyas; both reasons for honour stand together in Govinda.

verses.text:
वेदवेदाङ्गविज्ञानं बलं चाप्यमितं तथा ।
नृणां हि लोके कस्यास्ति विशिष्टं केशवादृते ॥

meaning.en: Knowledge of the Vedas and their limbs, and immeasurable strength too: who among men in the world is superior to Keshava?

verses.text:
दानं दाक्ष्यं श्रुतं शौर्यं ह्रीः कीर्तिर्बुद्धिरुत्तमा ।
संनतिः श्रीर्धृतिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिश्च नियताच्युते ॥

meaning.en: Generosity, skill, learning, valour, modesty, fame, supreme intelligence, humility, splendour, steadiness, contentment and prosperity are ever established in Achyuta.

verses.text:
तमिमं सर्वसंपन्नमाचार्यं पितरं गुरुम् ।
अर्च्यमर्चितमर्चार्हं सर्वे संमन्तुमर्हथ ॥

meaning.en: This one, endowed with everything, teacher, father and guru, worthy of worship and honoured, you should all accept as worthy.

verses.text:
ऋत्विग्गुरुर्विवाह्यश्च स्नातको नृपतिः प्रियः ।
सर्वमेतद्धृषीकेशे तस्मादभ्यर्चितोऽच्युतः ॥

meaning.en: Priest, teacher, relative by marriage, snataka, king and dear friend: all this is found in Hrishikesha, and therefore Achyuta has been honoured.

verses.text:
कृष्ण एव हि लोकानामुत्पत्तिरपि चाप्ययः ।
कृष्णस्य हि कृते भूतमिदं विश्वं समर्पितम् ॥

meaning.en: Krishna alone is the origin and dissolution of the worlds; for Krishna's sake this whole universe of beings has been brought into being.

verses.text:
एष प्रकृतिरव्यक्ता कर्ता चैव सनातनः ।
परश्च सर्वभूतेभ्यस्तस्माद्वृद्धतमोऽच्युतः ॥

meaning.en: He is the unmanifest nature and the eternal doer, beyond all beings; therefore Achyuta is the eldest of all.

verses.text:
बुद्धिर्मनो महान्वायुस्तेजोऽम्भः खं मही च या ।
चतुर्विधं च यद्भूतं सर्वं कृष्णे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: Intellect, mind, the great element, air, fire, water, space and earth, and the fourfold kinds of creatures: all rests in Krishna.

verses.text:
आदित्यश्चन्द्रमाश्चैव नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्च ये ।
दिशश्चोपदिशश्चैव सर्वं कृष्णे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: The sun, the moon, the stars and planets, the directions and intermediate directions: all rests in Krishna.

verses.text:
अयं तु पुरुषो बालः शिशुपालो न बुध्यते ।
सर्वत्र सर्वदा कृष्णं तस्मादेवं प्रभाषते ॥

meaning.en: But this person, the child Shishupala, does not understand Krishna anywhere or at any time; therefore he speaks thus.

verses.text:
यो हि धर्मं विचिनुयादुत्कृष्टं मतिमान्नरः ।
स वै पश्येद्यथाधर्मं न तथा चेदिराडयम् ॥

meaning.en: A wise man who sought out the highest dharma would see it as it truly is, not as this king of Chedi does.

verses.text:
सवृद्धबालेष्वथ वा पार्थिवेषु महात्मसु ।
को नार्हं मन्यते कृष्णं को वाप्येनं न पूजयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Among the kings, old and young, great-souled, who would not think Krishna worthy, or who would not honour him?

verses.text:
अथेमां दुष्कृतां पूजां शिशुपालो व्यवस्यति ।
दुष्कृतायां यथान्यायं तथायं कर्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: If Shishupala now decides that this honour was wrongly done, then let him do what is proper in view of the wrong.
